project.name: ucdt
project.description: UCDT v2 — Urban Climate Digital Twin for Ho Chi Minh City (flood, heat, air quality, what-if simulation, rule-based recommendations). Monorepo rewrite of Hackathon-BE/FE, sprint S-001. State at wave-2 gate: the whole chain runs locally end to end (worker -> Postgres -> climate API -> gateway -> web, SSE live). Not yet: full-stack compose + Caddy (T-010), CI completion + GHCR and deploy (T-012, T-013).

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: pnpm workspace root. Scripts: `pnpm parity` regenerates the golden fixture from the legacy TS backend. Every JS dependency for web/gateway/contracts was declared up front in T-001 — seam owners must not add dependencies (ask the lead).

nodes.name: compose.yml
nodes.summary: Production-shaped compose: postgis 16-3.4 + redis 7 only (no ports published, mem_limit sized for a 2 vCPU / 3.78 GB VPS). Redis runs with persistence OFF and allkeys-lru at 64 MB — it is a cache + pub/sub bus, never a store. App services (climate-api, worker, gateway, caddy+web) are added in T-010.

nodes.name: compose.dev.yml
nodes.summary: Dev override publishing postgres :5432 and redis :6379 on 127.0.0.1 so host processes (uv run, bun --watch, vite) reach them. Never used on the VPS.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: The only env template. VITE_* are baked into the static bundle at build time (not secrets; the Mapbox token is URL-scoped). SITE_ADDRESS=:80 serves by IP; a domain turns on Caddy auto-HTTPS.

nodes.name: climate.yml
nodes.summary: CI for services/climate: PostGIS service container, uv sync --locked, ruff check + format, pytest. Deliberately NO path filter — a required check skipped by a filter would block unrelated PRs.

nodes.name: gateway.yml
nodes.summary: CI for apps/gateway: bun test + tsc.

nodes.name: web.yml
nodes.summary: CI for apps/web: lint, vitest, vite build with a placeholder VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN (env.ts throws without one).

nodes.name: gen-parity.ts
nodes.summary: Golden-fixture generator: runs the LEGACY ../Hackathon-BE/src (read-only sibling repo, must be checked out next to ucdt) on canned inputs — pure-function grids plus 11 scenarios, each in a fresh child process with Date frozen, TZ=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh and fetch mocked. Output is services/climate/tests/fixtures/parity.json. LANDMINE: the fixture bakes in legacy B-012 (UTC current-hour pick), so the compute layer takes weather as given and the ingest fix is tested separately.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package docstring stating the rule: this package owns the DB schema, ingestion, every PDIM coefficient and formula, snapshots, rules and simulation. Nothing outside it computes a value it owns (DP3).

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: pydantic-settings Settings (DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL — defaults on 127.0.0.1, not localhost (::1 first on Windows: Redis timeouts, 2 s Postgres connects), optional IQAIR/AQICN keys, ingest every 15 min, stale after 45 min, city hcmc, tz Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh), cached by get_settings(). Reads services/climate/.env.

nodes.name: weather.py
nodes.summary: Open-Meteo forecast client + transform_forecast. B-012 fix: the current hour is matched in HCMC LOCAL time via Open-Meteo's utc_offset_seconds (not zoneinfo — Windows lacks tzdata and no dep may be added). Requests forecast_days=2 so 24 forecast hours always exist.

nodes.name: air.py
nodes.summary: Air-quality fetch: Open-Meteo Air Quality first, IQAir / AQICN fallbacks only when their keys are set. Returns None on failure; a failed station is dropped.

nodes.name: snapshots.py
nodes.summary: store_run(): one scoring run inside the CALLER's transaction — observations, the five risk_snapshots (weather, aqi, flood, heat, recommend; result = legacy /api/<hazard> data, model_version pdim-s1) and new alerts. LANDMINE: heat is stored in heatController's reshaped form (heat_payload), not compute_heat's raw output — the web and the API model depend on that.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: arq WorkerSettings: cron every ingest_interval_minutes + at startup: fetch all -> store_run -> commit -> publish ucdt:events. Any upstream failure skips the run (no half snapshot set). Run once: `uv run arq climate.worker.main.WorkerSettings --burst`.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI internal API (only client: the gateway). /v1/{hazard}/latest adds observedAt + stale (> 45 min); 503 until a snapshot exists (gateway turns it into 502). /v1/simulation runs live on the latest weather+flood+aqi snapshots. /v1/alerts, /v1/alerts/read, /v1/history/{hazard}?hours=1..168, /healthz.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic response/request models mirroring the legacy shapes; SimulationRequest bounds = validate_scenario. Source of the OpenAPI schema.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: One image for api (default CMD uvicorn :8000), worker (arq ...) and migrate (alembic upgrade head). uv, non-root uid 10001, ~300 MB.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: API tests on their own database `ucdt_test_api` (sharing ucdt_test with tests/db races: tests/db downgrades it to base).

nodes.name: test_worker.py
nodes.summary: Parity scenario through faked HTTP -> worker -> real DB: each stored result equals legacy /api/<hazard> within 1e-9; events only after commit; failed fetch writes nothing. DB `ucdt_test_worker`.

nodes.name: units.py
nodes.summary: The 63 spatial units: 18 FLOOD_ZONES, 22 HEAT_CELLS, 23 AQI_POINTS (+ ALL_UNITS). Named by coordinate-anchored TOPONYMS, never administrative units (district tier abolished 2025); `id` keeps the historic slug as an internal key only. localDrain/terrain/urbanDensity are expert-judgement constants pending Stage-2 calibration. Seeded into the DB by migration 001.

nodes.name: constants.py
nodes.summary: SINGLE source of truth for every PDIM Stage-1 coefficient: flood w1..w4 = .45/.30/.25/.15, Θ=(.25,.5,.75), rainRef 50 mm/h; heat α=0.15, UHI 3.5 °C; AQI β=0.3, γ_w=.05, γ_p=.15; green->drain 0.003; AQI_CATEGORIES bands. Ported verbatim from legacy constants.ts; parity-tested. One known web copy: the flood weights in apps/web features/flood (B-014, #26).

nodes.name: risk.py
nodes.summary: Scalar response functions (flood_risk_score R_f = w1P+w2T+w3I-w4D, flood_risk_level, heat_index, effective_temp, aqi_nowcast_step, estimated_depth_m) plus the JS-parity helpers js_round / to_fixed / js_iso. LANDMINE: use js_round, never Python round() — banker's rounding breaks payload parity at .5 ties; same for isoformat vs toISOString.

nodes.name: flood.py
nodes.summary: City + per-zone flood risk over the 18 zones. flood_areas() is shared by baseline and what-if so before/after run on ONE grid. Zones under 0.15 are not reported. Returns all four R_f terms (B-011).

nodes.name: heat.py
nodes.summary: Heat/UHI hotspots over the 22 heat cells from current temperature + humidity; heat_risk_level bands 37/40/44 °C.

nodes.name: aqi.py
nodes.summary: EPA PM2.5 -> US AQI breakpoints, Open-Meteo `current` -> raw mapping, the S1 gamma nowcast over 24 h and the AQIResponse assembly (city + 23 stations; a failed station is dropped, not zeroed).

nodes.name: simulation.py
nodes.summary: What-if Algorithm 2: validate_scenario bounds every lever (rainfall 0-500 %, duration 0-72 h, green ±100, traffic, urbanDensity) and rejects NaN/inf/bool; run_simulation re-scores flood, heat and AQI. urbanDensity reaches the UHI term (B-004). A dry day uses a 20 mm/h reference shower.

nodes.name: rules.py
nodes.summary: Rule base R: recommendations() and new_alerts(). Priority pi = S(b)·E(i)·F(a) with E(i)=min(1, 0.4+0.1·|affected zones|); S(b) 4/3/2/1 -> urgent/high/medium/low uniformly (B-008). Every recommendation carries ruleId, priorityScore and inputs (B-005 traceability). new_alerts dedupes against active alerts.

nodes.name: geo.py
nodes.summary: GeoJSON helpers: deterministic seeded 20-vertex flood blob per zone (grows with risk), feature builder, haversine.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy Core tables mirroring migration 001 (spatial_units, weather_obs, aqi_obs, risk_snapshots, alerts) plus a tiny Geography(Point,4326) type — no geoalchemy2, no ORM. Migrations own the schema; this file only types columns.

nodes.name: repo.py
nodes.summary: Async data access returning plain dicts: insert weather/aqi obs, insert_snapshot / latest_snapshot / history (oldest first), insert_alerts (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, returns only new ids), list_active_alerts, mark_alerts_read, list_spatial_units (lat/lng via ST_Y/ST_X). None of them commit — the caller owns the transaction.

nodes.name: session.py
nodes.summary: Cached async engine + sessionmaker. Usage: `async with get_sessionmaker()() as s, s.begin(): ...`.

nodes.name: env.py
nodes.summary: Async alembic env. Hand-written migrations, no autogenerate (no target_metadata). URL comes from config.attributes['url'] (tests) or Settings.

nodes.name: 001_initial.py
nodes.summary: Initial schema + seed of the 63 spatial_units from spatial/units.py. risk_snapshots store inputs AND result as JSONB with model_version, so every served score is reproducible.

nodes.name: test_pdim_parity.py
nodes.summary: Numeric parity with the legacy TS backend: every pure group and every scenario from parity.json within 1e-9, strings exact; simulationId/alert ids compared by shape only.

nodes.name: test_pdim_invariants.py
nodes.summary: Regression invariants for legacy bugs B-004, B-005, B-008, B-011 plus alert dedupe/refire and dropped-station AQI.

nodes.name: test_pdim_legacy.py
nodes.summary: Ports of legacy riskCalculator / scenarioValidation / spatialNaming tests, including the assertion that no API-surface name carries an administrative label.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: DB tests use a SEPARATE database `ucdt_test` on the DATABASE_URL server, created if missing and migrated once per session; each test runs in a rolled-back transaction. Needs compose postgres up.

nodes.name: parity.json
nodes.summary: Generated by tools/gen-parity.ts — do not hand-edit. 695 pure cases + 11 scenarios.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Bun entry (defaults CLIMATE_URL http://127.0.0.1:8000, REDIS_URL 127.0.0.1 — not localhost, which is slow on Windows): builds TWO RedisClients (commands + a dedicated pub/sub subscriber, B-013) and serves the Hono app on :3001 with idleTimeout 0 so SSE is not cut.

nodes.name: app.ts
nodes.summary: The public /api/* surface. Middleware: CORS *, secure headers, 64 KB body limit, logger, Redis rate limit. /api/{weather,aqi,flood,heat,recommend} -> GET /v1/<x>/latest with per-route cache TTL; alerts never cached; GET /api/simulation maps legacy query params onto the POST body; /api/stream relays Redis channel `ucdt:events`, using the JSON `type` field as the SSE event name.

nodes.name: climate.ts
nodes.summary: forward(): the ONLY code that talks to CLIMATE_URL. Wraps bare climate JSON in the legacy {success,data,timestamp,cached} envelope so Hackathon-FE keeps working; maps 404->404, FastAPI 422->400 with a flattened message, anything else non-2xx or unreachable -> 502.

nodes.name: cache.ts
nodes.summary: GET-only, 200-only Redis response cache keyed by full URL, X-Cache HIT/MISS. Fails OPEN when Redis is down.

nodes.name: rateLimit.ts
nodes.summary: 100 req/min per IP (first X-Forwarded-For hop) via INCR+EXPIRE, X-RateLimit-* headers, 429 with retryAfter. Fails OPEN when Redis is down.

nodes.name: redis.ts
nodes.summary: RedisLike: the slice of Redis the gateway uses; Bun's RedisClient satisfies it structurally, tests inject a fake.

nodes.name: fakes.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory Redis fake that, like real Redis, rejects key commands once subscribed (B-013 guard); a Redis that fails every call; a fake climate fetch.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: Browser entry: mounts <App/> in StrictMode.

nodes.name: App.tsx
nodes.summary: Provider stack: TanStack QueryClient, use-intl IntlProvider (vi/en from a zustand locale store), RouterProvider, devtools.

nodes.name: env.ts
nodes.summary: zod-validated env. VITE_API_BASE_URL may be EMPTY (same-origin /api via Vite proxy or Caddy). VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN is required — the app throws at import without it, including in CI builds.

nodes.name: routes.tsx
nodes.summary: The route table, in its own module so tests build a memory router from the exact shipped routes. /dashboard, /map, /simulation/{heat,flood,aqi}, /flood, /air-quality, /alerts; every page lazy-loaded. Nav shows only 4 tabs (Board decision 2026-09-14); air-quality and alerts are URL-reachable.

nodes.name: router
nodes.summary: Router plumbing: index (createBrowserRouter), lazyPage (code-split pages), RouteErrorBoundary, SimulationLayout (tab bar), NotFoundPage, routes.test.

nodes.name: dashboard
nodes.summary: Overview cards, risk banner, 24 h charts, rule-based RecommendPanel (ruleId/priorityScore/inputs, B-005). lib/weatherOutlook: a 'vs 24 h ago' delta only when history really spans >= 23 h, else the 6 h forecast outlook (B-007, B-015).

nodes.name: flood
nodes.summary: Flood page: per-zone table + RiskDecomposition of all four R_f terms, drainage drawn subtractive (B-010/B-011). LANDMINE: lib/decomposeFloodRisk.ts keeps its own copy of w1..w4 with no cross-check (B-014, #26) — change a flood weight in climate and this silently desyncs.

nodes.name: air-quality
nodes.summary: Air-quality page: stations, EPA bands from shared/lib/aqi.ts, provenance = Open-Meteo.

nodes.name: alerts
nodes.summary: Alerts page: list + mark-read (optimistic, persisted via POST /api/alerts/read).

nodes.name: map
nodes.summary: Full Mapbox map with flood/heat/AQI layers and controls. mapbox-gl stays in its own chunk; init failure (no WebGL) is logged and leaves the boot overlay up. Needs a real VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN to paint.

nodes.name: simulation
nodes.summary: Heat/flood/AQI what-if pages. No local PDIM: sliders debounce (150 ms) POST /api/simulation and render TanStack mutation state; zustand holds slider state only. SimHeatLayer shows only the backend tempDelta (B-006); urbanDensity is sent (B-004). The affected-population figure it shows is a legacy heuristic (B-016).

nodes.name: useLiveEvents.ts
nodes.summary: The app's single EventSource on /api/stream (mount once, in AppLayout). `snapshot.updated` {hazard} invalidates that hazard's query via the KEY registry; `alert.created` invalidates alerts. CONTRACT: the worker (T-006) must publish JSON with `type` in {snapshot.updated, alert.created} and `hazard` matching a KEY in shared/utils/queryKeys.ts, or live refresh silently does nothing.

nodes.name: axios.ts
nodes.summary: The single axios instance (baseURL from env, 10 s timeout) and unwrap(), which peels the gateway's {success,data} envelope.

nodes.name: queryKeys.ts
nodes.summary: KEY registry for TanStack Query keys; useLiveEvents maps SSE hazard names through it, so hook keys and invalidation cannot drift.

nodes.name: services
nodes.summary: One thin fetcher per endpoint (weather, aqi, flood, heat, history, recommend, simulation, alerts) — apiClient.get/post + unwrap, nothing computed.

nodes.name: hooks
nodes.summary: TanStack Query hooks over the services (useWeatherData, useAQIData, useFloodRisk, useHeatMap, useHistory, useRecommend, useSimulation, useAlerts, useMarkAlertsRead) plus useLiveEvents.

nodes.name: types
nodes.summary: Response types ported from Hackathon-FE. To be replaced/checked against packages/contracts once T-007 generates them from the OpenAPI schema.

nodes.name: aqi.ts
nodes.summary: US AQI display bands (colour + i18n code) used by every legend and marker. Display only — not a PDIM term; the AQI VALUE always comes from the API.

nodes.name: components
nodes.summary: Shared UI ported from Hackathon-FE: layout (AppLayout, Header, ThemeToggle, PageLoader), charts (recharts wrappers, AQIGauge, HeatmapGrid), common (RiskBadge, DataSourceTag, ErrorState...), map (3D buildings, terrain, boot overlay, layer lifecycle).

nodes.name: stores
nodes.summary: zustand stores for UI state only (city, map, simulation sliders, alerts panel, locale). Never cache server data here — that is TanStack Query's job.

nodes.name: ui
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui primitives (base-ui). Generated; excluded from ESLint.

nodes.name: messages
nodes.summary: i18n catalogues vi.json / en.json for use-intl.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: React Compiler via babel (slow builds by design), Tailwind v4, @ alias, rolldown codeSplitting groups keeping recharts and mapbox-gl off routes that do not use them. Dev proxy /api -> 127.0.0.1:3001 with timeouts disabled for SSE.

nodes.name: eslint.config.js
nodes.summary: Enforces feature isolation (features cannot import each other; shared cannot import a feature) — Board decision 2026-09-14.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: @ucdt/contracts: `gen` runs openapi-typescript over openapi.json (--default-non-nullable false so defaulted request fields stay optional).

nodes.name: openapi.json
nodes.summary: Generated by `uv run python -m climate.api.dump_openapi` — do not hand-edit. Regenerating must produce no diff (T-007 exit).

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Generated TS types for the climate API. Not yet consumed by apps/web, whose shared/types were ported by hand — known mismatches are on the board (T-007 follow-ups).

layers.name: Infrastructure and CI
layers.description: Compose (stateful services only until T-010), env template, GitHub Actions per service, and the one-shot parity generator.

layers.name: Processing layer — PDIM (pure Python)
layers.description: Every coefficient and formula of PDIM Stage 1, with no I/O, so one code path scores live snapshots, what-ifs and fixtures. Ported from Hackathon-BE with 1e-9 parity. Owner of DP3.

layers.name: Data layer — Postgres/PostGIS
layers.description: Ingest clients (Open-Meteo + AQ fallbacks), hand-written migrations, Core tables, a dict-returning async repository.

layers.name: Climate runtime — worker + API
layers.description: The two processes of the one climate image: the arq worker that ingests, scores and publishes every 15 min, and the internal FastAPI the gateway calls.

layers.name: Climate tests
layers.description: Parity against the legacy backend, regression invariants for legacy bugs, and DB tests on a throwaway ucdt_test database.

layers.name: Gateway — Bun + Hono
layers.description: The only public API. Envelope, cache, rate limit, SSE, CORS. Never touches the DB, never computes a domain value.

layers.name: Web shell
layers.description: Entry, providers, env, router and build config of the Vite SPA.

layers.name: Web shared layer
layers.description: Everything features may import: network, query hooks, live events, types, UI components, UI-only stores. Presentation only — it renders what the API computed.

layers.name: Web features
layers.description: The six screens, isolated from each other by ESLint; each renders what the API computed.

layers.name: Contracts
layers.description: OpenAPI schema dumped from the climate API and the TS types generated from it.

tour.title: The rule everything follows
tour.description: Python owns every PDIM number (DP3). The gateway only reshapes, the web only renders. Read the package docstring, then constants.py — every coefficient in the system is there and nowhere else.

tour.title: The formulas
tour.description: risk.py holds R_f, heat index, UHI and the AQI nowcast plus the JS-parity helpers; flood/heat/aqi assemble per-hazard responses over the 63 spatial units.

tour.title: What-if and rules
tour.description: simulation.py (Algorithm 2) and rules.py (pi = S·E·F, traceable recommendations, deduped alerts).

tour.title: How parity is proven
tour.description: gen-parity.ts runs the legacy backend to produce parity.json; test_pdim_parity asserts the port within 1e-9.

tour.title: How data arrives
tour.description: worker/main.py fetches Open-Meteo every 15 min, snapshots.store_run scores and stores five snapshots in one transaction, then publishes ucdt:events.

tour.title: Storage
tour.description: Migration 001 seeds the units; repo.py is the only data access and never commits.

tour.title: Where a browser request lands
tour.description: Gateway app.ts: rate limit, cache, then climate.ts forwards to the FastAPI /v1/* and wraps the legacy envelope. index.ts keeps a separate Redis connection for SSE (B-013).

tour.title: The web app
tour.description: routes.tsx lists every screen; shared/ services + hooks fetch and unwrap; useLiveEvents turns SSE into query invalidation.

tour.title: Run it
tour.description: compose.dev.yml for postgres + redis on loopback; then climate api (uvicorn), worker (arq --burst), gateway (bun), web (vite; API_PROXY_TARGET if :3001 is taken). Full compose arrives with T-010.
